# Epic: Release and quality

**Slug:** release-and-quality
**Status:** ready
**Created:** 2026-10-13

## Goal

CI on Windows, macOS and Ubuntu, quality gates, supply-chain protection, and a release pipeline with an independent update signature.

## Scope

- CI matrix, coverage floors, mutation and fuzz jobs
- Supply-chain checks, pinned actions
- Reproducible build, provenance, update key, GitHub Releases
- Accessibility harness and manual checklist

## Out of Scope

- OS code signing (gate for paid sync, tracked in sync-and-server)
